activity_summary: You looked at the roll after the two stops were moved. The speech was not copied onto the page. The marks said where the breath went. Sam was sitting to take the marks.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked at the marks he had just moved.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: The roll was his. He was still in the room.

entities.name: Sam Latchet
entities.context: Sat to copy the marks, not the lines.

entities.name: the Princess's part
entities.context: Mentioned in Two stops, and no words

facets.activity: Set down the two breath marks
